  packages/framework/core/sensors/amadeus-required-sections.md \

from pathlib import Path
import json

root = Path("amadeus")
needle = "260805-semi-redefine-autonomy-f"
paths = [p for p in root.rglob("*") if needle in str(p)]
print("path_count:", len(paths))
for p in paths[:100]:
    print(p)

for p in paths:
    if p.is_file() and p.suffix == ".jsonl":
        counts = {}
        matching = []
        for no, raw in enumerate(p.read_text(errors="replace").splitlines(), 1):
            try:
                obj = json.loads(raw)
            except Exception:
                continue
            fields = obj.get("fields", {})
            if fields.get("Stage slug") == "reverse-engineering":
                event = obj.get("event")
                counts[event] = counts.get(event, 0) + 1
                if event in {"SENSOR_FIRED", "SENSOR_PASSED", "SENSOR_FAILED"}:
                    matching.append((no, event, fields.get("Sensor ID"), fields.get("Output path")))
        if counts:
            print("audit:", p)
            print("counts:", counts)
            for item in matching:
                print(item)
